Job Title: AI Engineer
Experience: 2+ years
Location: Hybrid: Mumbai or Pune, 3 days a week in the office.
Mandatory Skills:
- Microsoft Copilot Studio
- Power Automate

Good to have:
- Dataverse
- SharePoint

Responsibilities:
- Join a product-focused engineering team at Velora Systems (fictional), building intelligent automation solutions that augment business workflows for enterprise clients.
- Design, prototype and deploy Copilot-driven assistants and conversational AI experiences using Microsoft Copilot Studio to surface contextual insights and automate user interactions.
- Build and maintain Power Automate flows to orchestrate cross-system processes, integrate APIs, and automate routine tasks across business units.
- Collaborate with product managers, UX designers and backend engineers to translate requirements into scalable automation solutions and low-code integrations.
- Implement secure connectors and data-handling patterns, ensuring compliance with organizational policies and best practices for enterprise deployments.
- Troubleshoot, monitor and optimize deployed automations for reliability, latency and cost; iterate based on user feedback and telemetry.
- Develop test cases, run end-to-end validations and produce documentation and runbooks for handover to operations.
- Mentor junior engineers and contribute to knowledge-sharing sessions on Copilot Studio and Power Automate capabilities.
- Engage with stakeholders to assess opportunities for extending automations, and evaluate feasibility of leveraging Dataverse and SharePoint where applicable.
